premises: Sputtered FeCoNiMnCu thin films are initially soft fcc with low coercivity (~10 Oe)
RTA of these films induces a single fcc phase with ~40-fold coercivity increase
Adding 50 at.% Pt and RTA yields an L1₀ phase with ~1000-fold coercivity increase
The coercivity increase in FeCoNiMnCu films is due to microstructural changes and strain-induced anisotropy enhancing domain wall pinning
The L1₀ phase in Pt-containing films provides high magnetocrystalline anisotropy from lower symmetry and strong spin-orbit coupling
